vrubric: A correct answer must: 1. Name the MECHANISM — wage accounts opened for workers who never operate them — salary credits are swept out within hours, cards are held centrally, and one address and device serve dozens of holders — the binding individual CDD step on every worker is met, yet that none of them controls the account in his own name, so the CDD identifies the holder but not the operator. 2. Explain the LOOPHOLE — the determinate rule/threshold/exemption is satisfied on its face, but its purpose is defeated (CDSA s.45, MAS Notice 626 para 6.21, FATF Rec 10, FATF Rec 1). 3. Cite the DISTINGUISHING FACTS (vs a legitimate look-alike) — a genuine customer would show: workers who hold their own cards, spend independently, and show the varied everyday activity of people living their own lives. Here that is absent. 4. Reach the right DECISION — report / escalate to compliance (do not proceed).
vstory: PROFILE: Occupation: 38 wage accounts opened for workers of one employer, all at one residential address.  ACTIVITY: Wage credits and what follows them:   Fri 06 Mar · in · S$1,400–1,650 salary to each of 38 accounts   Fri 06 Mar · out · 92% of each balance transferred to one account within 4 hours   No card spend, no ATM use, no discretionary activity on any of the 38   All 38 accessed from three devices; all registered to one address   (every account funded and emptied on the same cycle; residual balances near identical; no independent activity of any kind on any account since opening)  REQUEST: “I handle the banking for all my workers — they've each signed, so just open them.”

vrubric: A correct answer must: 1. Name the MECHANISM — small sums drawn from genuinely lawful earnings, each below every reporting and CDD threshold, aggregating through an intermediary to a recipient in a conflict-adjacent jurisdiction — the binding lawful-source test, and every applicable threshold is met, yet destination and purpose, which is what the concern turns on here rather than origin, and which no threshold test examines. 2. Explain the LOOPHOLE — the determinate rule/threshold/exemption is satisfied on its face, but its purpose is defeated (TSOFA, FATF Rec 5, MAS Notice 626 para 6.21). 3. Cite the DISTINGUISHING FACTS (vs a legitimate look-alike) — a genuine customer would show: donations to a registered charity with published accounts and a disbursement trail that can be followed to a named programme. Here that is absent. 4. Reach the right DECISION — report / escalate to compliance (do not proceed) — a lawful source does not answer a destination concern.
vstory: PROFILE: Occupation: salaried employee making frequent small transfers to an unregistered collector overseas.
